Prayer Song — Innate Technique (11th level)

Starting at 11th level, your abilities improve and find new heights. Only you gain these benefits against a creature you are fighting.

Turns Active Effect
1 Your AC and Dex Saves increase by +3
2 Your Enemies AC decreases by -3
3 You can add your Cursed Energy modifier to your attack and damage rolls
4 Your opponent has disadvantage on attacks and you have advantage on saving throws
5 Your attacks deal additional damage equal to your proficiency
6 Your opponent has their damage decreased by your proficiency
7 You gain an extra attack when you take the attack action
8 Your opponent's AC drops by a total of 5, and gains a -5 to saves.
9 Your critical range increases by 2.
10 Your opponent can only take an action, bonus action, or movement on their turn.
